tools.name: list_device_files
tools.description: Lists existing files in one directory on the operated iPhone's App Group, without uploading or changing files. path is relative; empty means the root. offset/limit slice MCP output only; the current iOS endpoint still enumerates the complete directory. MockFiles candidates include a config JSON string and 2 MiB budget, but metadata does not prove UTF-8/content validity. Use select_mock_file to validate and import/reuse an existing phone file. Reuse fetch_device_file only when content inspection is needed. This is not the iOS Files/iCloud picker.

tools.name: select_mock_file
tools.description: Selects an existing UTF-8 text file by path on the operated iPhone's App Group (not a computer path). The iPhone validates it, reuses a safe direct MockFiles reference or copies it into managed MockFiles storage, and returns a mock_file config JSON string without its content. Source files are unchanged. Maximum file content is 2 MiB. No upload from the computer, Files/iCloud picker or automatic rule save occurs. Attach new copied files promptly with upsert_rewrite_rule; unreferenced files may be reclaimed on app restart. Requires mock_files.import_app_group capability version 1.

tools.name: create_mock_file
tools.description: Creates a new managed UTF-8 text Mock file on the operated iPhone, mirroring the app's New File action. content defaults to empty and is limited to 2 MiB of UTF-8; filename defaults to mock.json and is a suggestion, not an overwrite path. Returns a mock_file config JSON string and metadata, without the text. To edit, fetch_device_file then create a new copy and update the rule reference with upsert_rewrite_rule; existing files/rules are unchanged by this tool. Never reads or uploads a computer file. Attach new files promptly with upsert_rewrite_rule; unreferenced files may be reclaimed on app restart. Requires mock_files.create capability version 1.

tools.name: prepare_remote_rewrite_script
tools.description: Downloads and preflights native Lemon ESM on the iPhone without persisting a script. Returns a caller-bound token valid for 10 minutes. Use it in a parent rule's remote_scripts or explicitly create a standalone resource.

url.description: Public HTTPS source URL. The iPhone downloads and preflights it.

isPrivate.description: Omit this source URL from sharing and cloud backups; the complete installed snapshot is still retained.

tools.name: create_remote_rewrite_script
tools.description: Explicitly installs a standalone remote script using a prepared token. For an unsaved rule, pass the token through remote_scripts to save the resource and rule atomically.

tools.name: get_remote_rewrite_script
tools.description: Reads a remote source's generation, validators, schedule, and controlled failure state. Source URLs may contain private query credentials; do not publish them.

tools.name: configure_remote_rewrite_script
tools.description: Changes source URL, permission ceiling, pin, or foreground auto-update settings using a generation CAS. It invalidates validators and does not replace the installed package; explicitly refresh to validate and install new content.

url.description: Public HTTPS source URL. The iPhone downloads and preflights it.

isPrivate.description: Omit this source URL from sharing and cloud backups; the complete installed snapshot is still retained.

tools.name: refresh_remote_rewrite_script
tools.description: Manually checks a normal remote script on the iPhone, bypassing its schedule. Conditional GET, integrity checks, preflight, atomic publish and runtime apply are shared with native UI. DRM content continues to use the existing licensed refresh channel.

tools.name: copy_remote_rewrite_script
tools.description: Copies an installed normal script snapshot to a new independent local script. No source URL or automatic subscription is copied.

tools.name: toggle_vpn
tools.description: Starts or stops the Lemon iOS VPN. Wait for success or error response.

action.description: Whether to start or stop the VPN capture

tools.name: open_web_page
tools.description: Opens an HTTP or HTTPS URL inside the Lemon iOS app's embedded WKWebView.

url.description: HTTP or HTTPS URL to open inside Lemon

tools.name: close_web_page
tools.description: Closes the Lemon iOS embedded WKWebView.

tools.name: refresh_web_page
tools.description: Reloads the current page in the Lemon iOS embedded WKWebView.

tools.name: go_back_web_page
tools.description: Navigates back in the Lemon iOS embedded WKWebView history.

tools.name: go_forward_web_page
tools.description: Navigates forward in the Lemon iOS embedded WKWebView history.

tools.name: list_scheduled_tasks
tools.description: Lists locally stored Cron or millisecond-interval JavaScript tasks, including runtime state and next run time.

tools.name: get_scheduled_task
tools.description: Fetches one locally stored Cron or interval JavaScript task by id.

tools.name: get_scheduled_task_runtime_status
tools.description: Returns the current PacketTunnel scheduled-task runtime state without exposing script source.

tools.name: create_scheduled_task
tools.description: Creates a locally stored Cron or millisecond-interval JavaScript task. Use script_type=single with script for one file, or script_type=package with script_package for a validated ESM package. Packages must export onSchedule(input) from their manifest entry. Interval values must be 250..86400000 ms. It is enabled by default unless enabled=false is provided.

cron_expr.description: Five-field Cron expression; required for schedule_type=cron

interval_ms.description: Fixed interval in milliseconds; required for schedule_type=interval

script_type.description: Whether the task uses one script file or an ESM script package

script.description: JavaScript source for a single task, or the entry source compatibility field for a package

script_package.description: Complete ESM package used when script_type=package

packageVersion.description: Supported package format version. Current value is 1.

entry.description: Relative entry module path, for example ./main.js.

module_id.description: Normalized relative module path, for example main.js.

enabled.description: Whether the task starts enabled; defaults to true

tools.name: update_scheduled_task
tools.description: Updates a locally stored Cron or millisecond-interval JavaScript task. Use script_type=single with script for one file, or script_type=package with script_package for a validated ESM package. Packages must export onSchedule(input) from their manifest entry.

cron_expr.description: Five-field Cron expression; required for schedule_type=cron

interval_ms.description: Fixed interval in milliseconds; required for schedule_type=interval

script_type.description: Whether the task uses one script file or an ESM script package

script.description: JavaScript source for a single task, or the entry source compatibility field for a package

script_package.description: Complete ESM package used when script_type=package

packageVersion.description: Supported package format version. Current value is 1.

entry.description: Relative entry module path, for example ./main.js.

module_id.description: Normalized relative module path, for example main.js.

tools.name: set_scheduled_task_enabled
tools.description: Enables or disables one scheduled task. Enabling scheduled execution requires the configured schedule entitlement.

enabled.description: Whether the task should be enabled

tools.name: delete_scheduled_task
tools.description: Deletes one locally stored scheduled task by id.

tools.name: clear_captured_traffic
tools.description: Clears all captured HTTP traffics and body binaries from the device.

tools.name: fetch_system_logs
tools.description: Safely reads the tail (end) of the Lemon core engine (lemoncore.log) to analyze system or runtime network errors. Suitable for large log files.

bytes.description: Number of bytes to read from the end. Default is 102400 (100KB, ~1500 lines). Increase only if deeply debugging.

tools.name: clear_system_logs
tools.description: Empties the Lemon core engine root logs (lemoncore.log). Useful to clean up logs before starting a fresh capture to isolate issues.

tools.name: list_host_mappings
tools.description: Lists the native DNS custom Host mappings currently applied by Lemon.

tools.name: upsert_host_mapping
tools.description: Creates a native DNS Host mapping, or updates one when an existing mapping id is provided. Writes are applied immediately and do not require a second confirmation.

id.description: Existing Host mapping UUID; omit to create a new mapping

enabled.description: Whether the mapping is active (default true)

domain.description: ASCII domain name to match, for example api.example.com

target.description: IPv4 or IPv6 target; omit for a block mapping

action.description: Map the domain to target, or block it (default map)

comment.description: Optional operator comment; use an empty string to clear it

tools.name: delete_host_mapping
tools.description: Deletes a native DNS custom Host mapping by UUID. The change is applied immediately without a second confirmation.

tools.name: search_traffic_previews
tools.description: Find HTTP traffic targeting specific keywords or hosts across recent logs.

keyword.description: Search term, URL substring, or Hostname

tools.name: get_captured_request
tools.description: Reads one complete captured request/response by transaction_id, trace_id, or the legacy database id returned by search_traffic_previews. Body metadata distinguishes missing, empty, text, and binary-file payloads.

trace_id.description: Stable request identifier returned as trace_id by search_traffic_previews.

tools.name: list_replay_items
tools.description: Lists saved HTTP replay items stored in Lemon's local runtime database.

tools.name: get_replay_item
tools.description: Reads one saved HTTP replay item by UUID, including its request headers and body.

tools.name: create_replay_item
tools.description: Saves a new HTTP replay item in Lemon's local runtime database. The item can later be executed with execute_replay_item.

headers.description: Request headers as a string map

tools.name: update_replay_item
tools.description: Updates a saved HTTP replay item without changing its execution history.

headers.description: Request headers as a string map

tools.name: delete_replay_item
tools.description: Deletes one saved HTTP replay item by UUID.

tools.name: execute_replay_item
tools.description: Executes one saved HTTP replay item through Lemon's native URLSession/runtime path and returns the response preview. Saved execution status is updated.

tools.name: execute_replay_request
tools.description: Executes a one-shot HTTP replay without saving it. Use this for a captured request after inspecting it with get_captured_request, or for an ad-hoc request.

headers.description: Request headers as a string map

tools.name: fetch_binary_payload
tools.description: Deep-dives into a specific HTTP payload by fetching its full request/response bodies.

path.description: The physical `.bin` path (e.g. `1234_req.bin`) discovered from previews.

tools.name: execute_raw_sql
tools.description: Executes a raw SQL diagnostic query on the Lemon SQLite database (Read-Only queries advised). For Int64 identifiers, SELECT CAST(id AS TEXT) AS id_text; bare large JSON numbers lose precision in JavaScript. Keep joins inside SQLite and project only necessary metadata.

query.description: Standard SQLite SQL string to execute on the database

tools.name: set_lemon_target_ip
tools.description: Manually override the target IP address of the iOS Lemon device. Use this if mDNS/Bonjour discovery fails or if the device relies on a different network IP.

ip.description: The physical IP address of the iOS device running Lemon (e.g. 192.168.1.10)

tools.name: get_lemon_target_ip
tools.description: Retrieves the current network URL/IP that the MCP is using to communicate with the iOS device.

tools.name: fetch_device_file
tools.description: Fetches a specific non-database file from the iOS device's AppGroup container. ESM rewrite script packages are stored in runtime.sqlite; use get_rewrite_script_package instead of looking for RewriteScripts/*.js files.

path.description: The relative path inside the AppGroup container (for example Logs/lemoncore.log or Bodies/response.bin)

tools.name: list_rewrite_scripts
tools.description: Lists ESM rewrite script packages with their ids, active revisions, and enabled state. Use get_rewrite_script_package to read source modules.

tools.name: get_rewrite_script_package
tools.description: Fetches the complete manifest and source modules for an active or historical ESM rewrite script revision.

revision.description: Optional historical revision. Omit to read the active revision.

tools.name: list_rewrite_script_revisions
tools.description: Lists immutable revisions for a rewrite script package, including content hashes, byte sizes, and the active revision.

tools.name: validate_rewrite_script_package
tools.description: Validates an ESM rewrite package with the same iOS-side manifest, module-path, and size rules used before persistence. It does not write anything.

packageVersion.description: Supported package format version. Current value is 1.

entry.description: Relative entry module path, for example ./main.js.

module_id.description: Normalized relative module path, for example main.js.

tools.name: upsert_rewrite_script
tools.description: Creates a new ESM rewrite script package or publishes a new immutable revision. Provide manifest/modules for multi-file packages, or content as a one-file shorthand. Set reload=true to request an immediate runtime snapshot reload after persistence.

id.description: Existing script package id. Omit to create a package.

name.description: Script name. Required when creating; optional when updating.

packageVersion.description: Supported package format version. Current value is 1.

entry.description: Relative entry module path, for example ./main.js.

modules.description: Complete module source list matching manifest.modules.

module_id.description: Normalized relative module path, for example main.js.

content.description: One-file shorthand. Converted to main.js with the default restricted permissions.

reload.description: Request an immediate rewrite snapshot reload after the package is stored.

tools.name: rollback_rewrite_script
tools.description: Makes an existing immutable revision the active revision for a rewrite script package. Historical revisions are retained.

reload.description: Request an immediate rewrite snapshot reload after switching the active revision.

tools.name: get_rewrite_runtime_status
tools.description: Reports whether rewrite and JavaScript execution are enabled, runtime resource limits, sync state, and script counts.

tools.name: get_rewrite_debug_events
tools.description: Reads the independent structured rewrite-debug event projection. Filter by trace, rewrite phase, or severity instead of scanning generic trace events.

trace_id.description: Optional HTTP trace id to inspect.

event_type.description: Optional event type, for example rule_matched, mutation_applied, script_failed, or rewrite_skipped.

level.description: Optional severity filter, for example info or warn.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return (default 200, maximum 1000).

offset.description: Number of newest matching events to skip.

tools.name: clear_rewrite_debug_events
tools.description: Clears structured rewrite-debug events. Provide trace_id to clear only one request; omit it only when intentionally clearing the whole debug projection.

trace_id.description: Optional HTTP trace id. When omitted, all rewrite-debug events are cleared.

tools.name: reload_rewrite_runtime
tools.description: Requests the active rewrite snapshot to reload from runtime.sqlite. This may fail when the VPN runtime is not running; persisted scripts are unaffected.

tools.name: delete_rewrite_script
tools.description: Delete a rewrite script by its numeric ID.

tools.name: list_rewrite_rules
tools.description: Fetches all existing rewrite policies and their MatchGroups. Use each policy id_text decimal string as rule.id when updating, or as delete_rewrite_rule id. The legacy numeric id may exceed JavaScript safe integer precision. Construct policy metadata explicitly; do not pass id_text or other read-only fields back in rule_json. This response includes all rule bodies, so use narrow read-only SQL with CAST(id AS TEXT) for bounded checks.

tools.name: upsert_rewrite_rule
tools.description: Add or update a rewrite policy with ordered MatchGroups. Supports host/path/query/method conditions and URL expressions. Checks device host-wildcard support before saving; disabling an existing policy remains available. To update, ensure the rule object has an 'id'.

rule_json.description: JSON string specifying Policy metadata. For updates set id to the original id_text decimal string, or a safe positive integer. Omit id_text and read-only fields. Unsafe numeric ids are rejected. Example: {"name":"Mock API","enabled":true,"priority":100}

groups_json.description: JSON string array of MatchGroup objects. Each group has group_key, order, match_mode (default/expression), match_expression, host/path/query/method conditions (AND in default mode) and actions. Host eq/prefix/suffix/contains accept * and ? on supported devices; leading *. includes the root domain. Multiple groups are evaluated in order without short-circuiting.

remote_scripts_json.description: Optional JSON array from prepare_remote_rewrite_script. New resources: {temporary_id:string,name,token}, IDs 9000000000000000..9007199254740991 referenced by actions. Shared source edits: {temporary_id:string,script_id,source_generation,active_revision,name,token}, using current metadata. The iPhone commits resources and the parent rule atomically.

tools.name: delete_rewrite_rule
tools.description: Delete a rewrite rule by its exact id_text decimal string, or a safe positive integer. Large JavaScript numbers are rejected to prevent deleting the wrong policy. Use list_rewrite_rules id_text or SELECT CAST(id AS TEXT) to obtain the original identifier.

id.description: Exact policy id: prefer the id_text decimal string returned by list_rewrite_rules (1..9223372036854775807, no leading zeros). Numeric input must be a safe positive JavaScript integer.

tools.name: get_rewrite_schema
tools.description: Returns the exact JSON schema and accepted enum values for creating or updating Rewrite Rules and Actions.

tools.name: list_modules
tools.description: Lists installed host-side UI Modules, active revisions, and enabled state.

tools.name: get_module_package
tools.description: Fetches the complete manifest and ESM sources for an active or historical Module revision.

tools.name: list_module_revisions
tools.description: Lists immutable Module revisions, hashes, and the active revision.

tools.name: validate_module_package
tools.description: Validates a Module package using the iOS validator without persisting it.

package_json.description: Complete JSON package with manifest and sources

tools.name: upsert_module
tools.description: Installs a new Module or publishes a new immutable revision. Optionally reloads the host runtime.

package_json.description: Complete JSON package with manifest and sources

reload.description: Reload all active Module workers after persistence

tools.name: rollback_module
tools.description: Switches a Module to an immutable historical revision; history is retained.

reload.description: Reload this Module worker after rollback

tools.name: toggle_module
tools.description: Enables or disables one installed UI Module.

enabled.description: Whether the Module can be opened

tools.name: delete_module
tools.description: Deletes an installed UI Module and all of its immutable revisions.

tools.name: get_module_runtime_status
tools.description: Reports active Module workers, leases, and runtime limits.

tools.name: reload_module_runtime
tools.description: Releases one Module worker or all workers so the next activation loads the active revision.

module_id.description: Optional Module id; omit to reload all

tools.name: inspect_module
tools.description: Fetches the active manifest, UI schema, and ESM sources of one installed Module.

tools.name: install_module
tools.description: Compatibility alias for installing or publishing a Module package.

package_json.description: Complete JSON package with manifest and sources

tools.name: set_module_enabled
tools.description: Compatibility alias for enabling or disabling one UI Module.

enabled.description: Whether the Module can be opened
